title: Domino Principle
statementMd:
Vasya is interested in arranging dominoes. He is fed up with common dominoes and he uses the dominoes of different heights. He put $*n*$ dominoes on the table along one axis, going from left to right. Every domino stands perpendicular to that axis so that the axis passes through the center of its base. The $*i*$-th domino has the coordinate $*x*_{*i*}$ and the height $*h*_{*i*}$. Now Vasya wants to learn for every domino, how many dominoes will fall if he pushes it to the right. Help him do that.

Consider that a domino falls if it is touched strictly above the base. In other words, the fall of the domino with the initial coordinate $*x*$ and height $*h*$ leads to the fall of all dominoes on the segment $[*x* + 1, *x* + *h* - 1]$.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1761e5ac5e8ac6ed462b17e474ba0d0bc66307ba.png)

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) which is the number of dominoes. Then follow $*n*$ lines containing two integers $*x*_{*i*}$ and $*h*_{*i*}$ ($- 10^{8} ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{8}, 2 ≤ *h*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{8}$) each, which are the coordinate and height of every domino. No two dominoes stand on one point.

## Output

Print $*n*$ space-separated numbers $*z*_{*i*}$ — the number of dominoes that will fall if Vasya pushes the $*i*$-th domino to the right (including the domino itself).
statementZhMd:
瓦ся对排列多米诺骨牌很感兴趣。他已经厌倦了普通的多米诺骨牌，转而使用高度不同的多米诺骨牌。他将 $*n*$ 个多米诺骨牌沿一条轴从左到右放在桌面上。每个多米诺骨牌都垂直于该轴放置，使得该轴穿过其底面的中心。第 $*i*$ 个多米诺骨牌的坐标为 $*x*_{*i*}$，高度为 $*h*_{*i*}$。现在，瓦ся想知道，对于每个多米诺骨牌，如果将它向右推倒，会有多少个多米诺骨牌倒下。请帮助他完成计算。

如果多米诺骨牌在高于底部的位置被触碰，则认为它会倒下。换句话说，初始坐标为 $*x*$、高度为 $*h*$ 的多米诺骨牌倒下，会导致所有位于区间 $[*x* + 1, *x* + *h* - 1]$ 上的多米诺骨牌倒下。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1761e5ac5e8ac6ed462b17e474ba0d0bc66307ba.png)

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$），表示多米诺骨牌的数量。接下来 $*n*$ 行每行包含两个整数 $*x*_{*i*}$ 和 $*h*_{*i*}$（$- 10^{8} ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{8}, 2 ≤ *h*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{8}$），分别表示每个多米诺骨牌的坐标和高度。任意两个多米诺骨牌不会位于同一点。

## 输出格式

输出 $*n*$ 个用空格分隔的数字 $*z*_{*i*}$——如果瓦ся将第 $*i*$ 个多米诺骨牌向右推倒，将会倒下的多米诺骨牌数量（包括它自身）。
